lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters visible posterior to the branchial region. Approximately five vertical columns of blobs are discernible, with the highest-intensity local maxima concentrated along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form grid-like anchor nodes, where the highest luminance blobs are centered.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and lower luminance (shadow) on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct elongated, low-luminance silhouettes attached to the ventral-lateral region, likely Echeneidae specimens.
